answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 163748 Country: India Title: My father is doing Hajj & Umrah service business from 1996. Alhamdulillah, now I'm with him in the business. But I have a doubt whether we can do Haj & Umrah as a business. Kindly advice me. Question: My father is doing Hajj & Umrah service business from 1996. Alhamdulillah, now I'm with him in the business. But I have a doubt whether we can do Haj & Umrah as a business. Kindly advice me. Answer ID: 163748 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1283/1100/B=12/1439) He may do the business of Hajj and Umrah tour. Thus you should bear in mind not to tell a lie to the Hajis nor deceive them nor create any problem for them in their accommodation and food etc. If you deceive Hajis and trouble them in accommodation then your income shall be unlawful or doubtful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
